title: Jala and the Stony Ground
logline: Jala plants a hidden seed in Nour, the hardest ground of all.
story: Nothing had ever grown in Nour, who was light — ground so hard the others laughed when Jala, who carried clearness after rain, was handed a single seed and told to plant it there. Jala did not argue; Jala simply returned each day to tend the barren place. No green came for a long season, and still Jala watered the stone. Then one morning a thread of root had split the rock from within. What force could not break, patience had quietly opened.
moral: What force cannot break, steady and patient tending opens from within.
